name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User requested continuing the planned optimization after the compact-input cleanup; Test14 was not separately device-validated, so Test15 also accepts Test13 as an upgrade base and carries the compact UI forward.

features: keep the short 粘贴链接 input and hide technical CID/mode/hash details from normal rows
remove the redundant in-page center title so the system page title remains the only page heading
show useful task state details only: status, percent, speed, remaining time, size and compact task time when available
show total task count and page count on the save-directory row without exposing internal IDs

completed-task click performs an on-demand result check: a direct video file plays immediately; a directory with exactly one non-noise top-level video also plays immediately; multi-video/nested cases continue to the existing smart 115OfflineResult page
keep long-press technical/management actions out of the normal visual flow: open result page, copy source link, copy info_hash, remove task record while keeping files, retry failed tasks
preserve the validated external magnet low-frequency focusMode chain and the established save-directory priority

evidence.offlineTaskContract: SheltonZhu/115driver OfflineTask exposes add_time, last_update, left_time, rateDownload, percentDone, file_id and wp_path_id; the existing 115Api wrapper already exposes the normalized counterparts used by current pan115 code.
evidence.existingResultContract: 115OfflineResult already scans nested results and separates primary videos from noise/extras, so Test15 only adds a conservative single-video fast path and falls back to that existing result page.

safety.pageLoadTaskRequests: one listOfflineTask call per page load
safety.completedFastPathRequests: only after explicit completed-task click; at most getFile plus one top-level getFiles request before fallback

validationTarget: input remains compact and normal task rows do not show raw info_hash/CID/internal mode
running tasks show useful progress/speed/remaining time when 115 provides those fields
completed tasks show compact size/time information
single-video completed tasks play directly when detected
multi-video or nested results still open the existing smart result page
long-press task record removal still keeps downloaded files
search, file management, recycle bin and external magnet call remain unchanged
supersededReason: User chose to continue with the next planned optimization area before separately validating Test15; Test16 carries the Test15 offline center forward unchanged.
